run_pseudo_labelling: run pseudo-labelling of audio data using a pretrained Whisper model for distillation preparation
concatenate_audio_samples: concatenate audio samples from the same speaker up to a maximum duration in a dataset
generate_whisper_transcriptions: generate Whisper model transcriptions for an audio dataset and save as CSV
compute_wer_metrics: compute word error rate metrics comparing predicted and reference transcriptions
save_pseudo_labelled_dataset: save pseudo-labelled dataset with transcriptions to disk and optionally push to Hugging Face Hub
